synopsis: RoadRunner Scenario is identified as a commercial scenario-generation and test-management tool, described as adaptable for off-road use; the latest release found was R2026b [f8361, f9193, f9194, f9197, f16023]. The RoadRunner family, including Scenario, builds and edits 3D environments, imports GIS, HD maps and point clouds, reconstructs recorded scenes, and parameterizes scenarios [f8605]. The family supports exports to CARLA, dSPACE ASM and IPG CarMaker using formats including OpenDRIVE and OpenSCENARIO, while RoadRunner Scenario specifically supports OpenSCENARIO, MATLAB and gRPC interfaces [f8606, f9195]. Both the tools chapter and glossary place it in a middle-cost MATLAB/Simulink stack with off-road, Unreal and sensor components; the glossary adds Mevea or AGX Dynamics coupled through FMI for terrain, hydraulics and machine variants [f9285, f16162]. Pricing is available by quote, whereas an unofficial January 2024 price-list copy gives indicative annual/perpetual figures of 3,400/13,600 in presumed US dollars, rather than a confirmed current price [f9196, f8390, f16145].
